programs.title: UNFPA internship: Logistics Administrative Support (Kinshasa)
programs.overview: Six-month internship in the UNFPA country office in Kinshasa, supporting the logistics of the national census operations: filing and archiving, tracking tools, dashboards and status reports.
programs.deadline_text: Posted 23 September 2026; closes 7 October 2026 at 22:59 UTC (23:59 Kinshasa time), as read on UNFPA's own posting data on 5 October 2026. Closed: on 12 October 2026 the posting no longer appears in UNFPA's careers data and UNFPA lists no position in Kinshasa.
funding_details: UNFPA posting: "Les stagiaires ne perçoivent pas de salaire"; interns receive an allowance towards basic daily expenses if they do not already have financial support.
UNFPA does not provide medical insurance to interns.
programs.stipend: Daily subsistence allowance only if not supported by an institution
programs.experience_requirement: Some academic, professional or volunteer experience is an advantage, not a requirement.
programs.education_requirement: Enrolled in a bachelor's programme with at least one academic year completed, or in a master's programme, or graduated and starting within a year of graduation
eligibility: Enrolled in a first university degree (licence or equivalent) with at least one year completed, or enrolled in a master's programme, or starting within one year of graduating
Fluent French; English is an asset
No nationality condition stated on the posting
documents_required: Application through the UNFPA candidate portal
potential_issues: Unpaid apart from an allowance for daily expenses; interns arrange their own medical insurance
UNChannel still lists this internship with the date 2 November 2026; that appears to be the aggregator's own listing date, not UNFPA's deadline
programs.action: This call has closed; watch UNFPA's careers site for the next internship in Kinshasa.
programs.notes: The posting was read through UNFPA's public careers data on 5 October 2026: 'Stagiaire - Logistics Administrative Support, Kinshasa, RDC'.

programs.title: UNON/OIF Fellowship Programme for Young African Interpreters (2026 cohort)
programs.organization: United Nations Office at Nairobi (UNON) with the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie (OIF)
programs.overview: A six-week paid training fellowship in Nairobi for young African conference interpreters with French as their A or retour language who recently graduated from a PAMCIT member university.
programs.deadline_text: "Applications must be received no later than 11:59 p.m. Nairobi time on 8 October 2026" (UNON call for applications, read 5 October 2026). An online assessment is tentatively planned for 10 October 2026.
funding_details: UNON call: "a monthly stipend of USD 3,000; a one-time settling-in grant of USD 1,300; return air travel ...; medical insurance coverage arrangements."
programs.stipend: USD 3,000 a month plus a USD 1,300 settling-in grant
programs.age_requirement: Under 35 at the time of application
programs.education_requirement: Master's degree in conference interpreting from a PAMCIT member university (Nairobi, Buea, Ghana, Gaston Berger, Maputo Pedagogical), obtained within the last three years
nationality_requirements: Young African professionals; open only to graduates of PAMCIT member universities
programs.language_requirement: French as A or retour language; English as B or C
eligibility: Master's in conference interpreting from a PAMCIT member university within the last three years
French A or retour, English B or C
application_process: Send one PDF (motivation letter and CV in French, degree and transcripts, passport page) by email as described in the UNON call
potential_issues: Only for graduates of five PAMCIT universities, none of them in the DRC
programs.action: This call has closed; watch unon.org and francophonie.org for a future cohort.
